unitTitle: B2 · Technology and privacy: reason through possibilities
title: Listening practice
subtitle: B2 · Unit 6: B2 · Technology and privacy: reason through possibilities

steps.title: Listen once
steps.body: In the real test you hear each recording once. Tap the speaker, listen, then choose. Do not replay. Never leave a question empty.

steps.fr: Si l'équipe publie les paramètres avant le lancement, les utilisateurs pourront choisir. Le résultat dépendra toutefois de la clarté des explications.
steps.question: What is the stated condition?
steps.explain: The settings must be published before the launch.

steps.fr: Si nous avions demandé l'avis des utilisateurs, nous aurions probablement repéré ce problème plus tôt.
steps.question: What does the speaker imply?
options: The team has already resolved every issue
The problem is unrelated to the test
The team did not ask early enough and may have missed the problem
steps.explain: The unreal past suggests earlier feedback did not happen.

steps.fr: La fonction pourrait simplifier la démarche, à condition que chacun puisse la désactiver facilement.
steps.question: What must be true for the feature to be acceptable?
options: Users can easily turn it off
The function works only on new devices
The application removes the other method
steps.explain: The condition is that users can easily disable the feature.
